metadata.title: Urban Mixtape Cover with High-Contrast Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy urban composition featuring a central figure leaning against a luxury vehicle, characterized by a split-tone background and aggressive, multi-layered typography.
triggerTerms: bold blocky text with brush script overlay
luxury car portrait with smoke background

recipe.visualDefinition: A central male figure in flamboyant streetwear leans against the grille of a luxury car. The background is a dramatic, smoky magenta, while the foreground transitions into a cool, hazy blue. The right side is dominated by massive, stacked white sans-serif typography, partially obscured by a light blue, textured brush-script layer.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject leaning against a vertical car grille as a central anchor
Warm magenta top half contrasting with cool blue bottom half
Massive blocky text layered behind expressive hand-drawn script
Subject's pink patterned jacket echoing the background color palette
coreInvariants: Aggressive vertical stacking of display typography
Atmospheric smoke or haze effects obscuring the lower third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned slightly left of center, medium-full shot, leaning diagonally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical chrome grille of the luxury car serves as the central structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down to the hands/money, then sweep right across the large typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense composition with minimal negative space, filled by smoke and large-scale lettering.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool Blue (foreground haze and script text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background smoke; high value contrast between white text and dark car/background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold geometric sans-serif and textured dry-brush script
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses ultra-heavy weights with minimal kerning
Secondary script uses a slanted, rough-edged brush stroke
Vertical stacking creates a wall-of-text effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are tightly tracked to the point of touching
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Super-heavy geometric sans-serif paired with a chaotic, textured script for tension.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky presence for the background text.
Captures the aggressive, textured feel of the script overlay.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a pink patterned fur jacket leaning against a luxury car grille. Use a split-tone background with magenta smoke at the top and blue haze at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add massive, vertically stacked white sans-serif text on the right side. Overlay a light blue, textured brush-script word diagonally across the center of the white text.

verificationChecks: Is the text stacked vertically on the right?
Does the color transition from magenta to blue?
Is the script text textured like a dry brush?
Is the subject leaning against a car grille?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white text is bold enough to be a 'wall'
Check that the blue script is clearly legible over the white
Verify the magenta/blue split is balanced
Confirm the subject's pose feels integrated with the car
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Split-Tone Smoke + Stacked Block Typography + Textured Script Overlay
